awakening.title: The awakening
text: You wake up in a dark room.
The floor is cold. The air smells of dust and old paper.
awakening.name: Your name… it comes back to you:

lookAround.title: Nowhere
text: You look around. Everything is dark. Your eyes adjust, slowly.
Books. Everywhere. From floor to ceiling, as far as the eye can see.
You recognise nothing. No memory of the way here.
Your left hand is clutching something. Two books: a strange notebook, your name on the label… and a white book.

whiteBook.title: The white book
text: Why does it feel so familiar?
And yet, you cannot make sense of it.

firstBook.title: The voice
text: Books, everywhere: on the walls, on the floor…
And then that voice in your head: what is the meaning of all this?

firstKnowledge.title: A sentence
text: In the middle of the gibberish, between two strings of letters that mean nothing, a sentence. A real one. You understand it.
You read it again and again, afraid it might fade away.
